records.name: Spirit Explosion
records.effect: Creates a close-range blue explosion that knocks opponents away.

records.name: Turn Retreat
records.effect: Spins backward while allowing directional control; can strike and stun nearby opponents.

records.name: High Tension Turn
records.effect: Feints a back jump, then rushes forward with a punch and knocks the opponent away.

records.name: Spirit Slash
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 2 - A Deal?! The Saiyan Brothers
records.effect: Close-range spinning slash that knocks the opponent away; the DBS Super Hero version costs 300 Stamina and can be charged to teleport behind the opponent.

notes: Ultimate Finish requirements were left null because the reviewed evidence establishes acquisition but does not explicitly establish an Ultimate Finish requirement. High Tension Turn is treated as character-only based on the current skill page's listed users and the absence of Future Warrior acquisition.
